description.zh: 模拟 Codex 多 Agent 完整工作流：模型调用 spawn_agent 工具 → AgentControl::spawn_agent() 六步创建子 Agent → Config 继承（sandbox/approval/cwd）与 History 隔离 → Mailbox 通信（父等待 / 子完成通知）→ spawn_agents_on_csv CSV 批处理 → 深度限制自动降级。
description.en: Simulate complete Codex multi-agent workflow: model calls spawn_agent tool → AgentControl::spawn_agent() six-step child creation → Config inheritance (sandbox/approval/cwd) with History isolation → Mailbox communication (parent wait / child completion) → spawn_agents_on_csv CSV batch processing → depth limit auto-downgrade.

annotation.zh: Feature::Collab（配置 key=multi_agent）默认开启，向模型提供完整多 Agent 工具集。SubAgentSource 枚举记录每个子 Agent 的创建来源，用于在客户端重建 Agent 树结构。
annotation.en: Feature::Collab (config key=multi_agent) is on by default, providing the full multi-agent toolset to the model. SubAgentSource enum records each sub-agent's creation source, used to reconstruct agent tree in clients.

steps.content: 帮我分析这个 mono-repo 的所有微服务，并为每个服务生成独立的架构文档

annotation.zh: 需要并行处理多个子任务，模型决定 spawn 多个子 Agent 分工处理。
annotation.en: Multiple subtasks need parallel processing; model decides to spawn multiple sub-agents for division of labor.

annotation.zh: 模型调用 spawn_agent（V2 格式，task_name 必填）。fork_turns=none 表示子 Agent 历史完全隔离，不复制父线程上下文。子 Agent 路径为 /root/current/auth-service-docs。
annotation.en: Model calls spawn_agent (V2 format, task_name required). fork_turns=none means child agent history is fully isolated. Child agent path: /root/current/auth-service-docs.

annotation.zh: spawn_agent_internal() 六步原子流程。最后启动 maybe_start_completion_watcher：一个独立的 tokio::spawn task 通过 watch::Receiver<AgentStatus> 监听子 Agent 状态，完成时向父线程注入完成通知。
annotation.en: spawn_agent_internal() six-step atomic flow. Finally starts maybe_start_completion_watcher: an independent tokio::spawn task monitors child agent status via watch::Receiver<AgentStatus>, injecting completion notification to parent when done.

annotation.zh: V2 返回 task_name + nickname。客户端通过 CollabAgentToolCall 事件（app-server-protocol/v2.rs:4631）看到子 Agent 状态变化：InProgress → Completed。
annotation.en: V2 returns task_name + nickname. Clients see child agent status changes via CollabAgentToolCall event (v2.rs:4631): InProgress → Completed.

annotation.zh: 父 Agent 调用 wait_agent 等待所有子 Agent 完成。V2 模式通过订阅 mailbox seq number（watch::Receiver<u64>）检测任何 Agent 发送消息；V1 模式直接订阅 AgentStatus watch channel。
annotation.en: Parent agent calls wait_agent to wait for all children. V2 mode detects via mailbox seq number (watch::Receiver<u64>); V1 mode directly subscribes to AgentStatus watch channel.

annotation.zh: 三个子 Agent 均完成。maybe_start_completion_watcher 的 tokio::spawn 任务已通过 inject_user_message_without_turn 将各子 Agent 的完成信息注入父线程对话历史。父 Agent 现在可以汇总结果。
annotation.en: All three sub-agents completed. maybe_start_completion_watcher's tokio::spawn tasks have injected each child's completion info into parent thread history via inject_user_message_without_turn. Parent can now aggregate results.
